limitations: The primary PDF references Supplementary Figure, Supplementary Tables 1 and 2, and Supplementary Methods, but those materials were not embedded in the evaluated PDF and no separate supplement was present in the source folder.
Atoms represent assertions in the evaluated primary article only; cited external studies in the Discussion were not atomized as if they were primary results from this study.
No phenotypic susceptibility testing or treatment-outcome data were available in the study; molecular resistance-associated classifications are preserved as the authors defined them.
